tagline: Two-page editorial-style resume for a graphic designer, with a mint accent rule and Iconify-backed contact and social glyphs.
notes: Two-page CV reference created from supplied screenshots. reference.png points to page 1 for compatibility; reference-page-1.png and reference-page-2.png preserve both source pages. revision-003 is the first revision wired into the documented asset flow. revision-004 closes page-2 reference-parity gaps: Expertise badge swapped to mdi:check-circle-outline at 38pt, social icons swapped to entypo-social:*-with-circle at 13pt, Awards and References rebuilt as real two-column TableBuilder grids; per-icon point sizes now flow through asset-request.json -> assets-manifest.json.
